description: TeemeupAI helps golfers find golf courses by name, address, or city and state; view course details, hours, and public reviews; check the weather for a course on a chosen date; read current golf headlines; book a tee time end to end by listing availability, choosing green fees, and completing checkout; view their own upcoming and past reservations; and leave a review for a course they played.

defaultPrompt: Find golf courses near Austin, TX and show me tee times for this Saturday.
What's the weather at Greenway Pines on Saturday, and what are the latest PGA Tour headlines?
Show me my upcoming tee time reservations.
